name: Corn & Soybeans: Carry Quintile Forward Return Analysis
description: Quintile sort on futures carry (cont.carry, already normalized as spread/back-contract price) for corn (ZC) and soybeans (ZS). Rank 1 = deepest contango, Rank 5 = deepest backwardation. Uses percentrank(period=2520) for a rolling ~10-year percentile, bucketed into 5 quintiles. Tests monotonicity: does deeper backwardation predict higher 63-day forward price returns? Shows average return and hit rate by quintile.
source:
# Corn & Soybeans: Carry Quintile Forward Return Analysis
# cont.carry is already normalized (spread / back-contract price)
# percentrank(2520) → rolling ~10yr percentile (0-100 scale)
# Q1 = deepest contango (rank 0-20), Q5 = deepest backwardation (rank 80-100)
# Tests: does deeper backwardation predict higher 63-day forward returns?

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
carry = cont.carry

# --- Rolling Percentile Rank (0-100 scale) ---
carry_rank = percentrank(period=2520)(carry)

# --- Quintile Buckets ---
is_q1 = is_valid(carry_rank) and carry_rank <= 20
is_q2 = is_valid(carry_rank) and carry_rank > 20 and carry_rank <= 40
is_q3 = is_valid(carry_rank) and carry_rank > 40 and carry_rank <= 60
is_q4 = is_valid(carry_rank) and carry_rank > 60 and carry_rank <= 80
is_q5 = is_valid(carry_rank) and carry_rank > 80

# --- Forward 63-Day Price Return ---
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# --- Quintile-Filtered Forward Returns ---
fwd_q1 = where(is_q1, fwd_63d)
fwd_q2 = where(is_q2, fwd_63d)
fwd_q3 = where(is_q3, fwd_63d)
fwd_q4 = where(is_q4, fwd_63d)
fwd_q5 = where(is_q5, fwd_63d)

# --- Hit Rates (ternary → Mean = hit rate) ---
hit_q1 = where(is_q1, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)
hit_q2 = where(is_q2, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)
hit_q3 = where(is_q3, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)
hit_q4 = where(is_q4, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)
hit_q5 = where(is_q5, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT: 1 category, 1 bar chart + 1 summary table
# ============================================================

# 1. PUNCHLINE — Avg 63d forward return by carry quintile (monotonicity test)
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Avg 63-Day Return by Carry Quintile',
    category='Carry Quintile Analysis',
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 Deepest Contango', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3', color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4', color=Color.Cyan),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q5 Deepest Backwardation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, fwd_q5))

# 2. REFERENCE — Summary table: N, Avg Return, Hit Rate, Median Return per quintile
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Carry Quintile Analysis',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='63-Day Forward Return Stats by Carry Quintile',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Obs Count', 'Avg Return', 'Hit Rate (>0)', 'Median Return'],
        col_headers=['Q1 (Contango)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5 (Backwardation)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    order=2
)(fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, fwd_q5, fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, fwd_q5, hit_q1, hit_q2, hit_q3, hit_q4, hit_q5, fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, fwd_q5)
